protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: query() accepted org_id, copied the caller scope including its ACLManager through ScopeBuilderFromScope, then replaced only builder.Config with the target org config; this let a notebook user carry source-org privileges into another org.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: CONFIRMED: 416a2e9d7e076b49aa532db6bbb257ecccf596d3 is the smallest reconstructable first-write commit: its query.go diff adds OrgId and the target-org builder.Config assignment without rebinding ACLManager.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: CONFIRMED: the BIC parent is 28dd0366ec194e798210eaa2b9c527cec2143084, whose vql/tools/query.go has neither OrgId nor any target-org Config switch, so the vulnerable cross-org path is absent.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: CONFIRMED: GitHub PR #1949 exposes members 416a2e9d7e076b49aa532db6bbb257ecccf596d3, e213f4056ed3bfed620207405c9dedd804bb8a91, and f7b1b84b6a491c09b2b590273e974fd7e555d012 and squash carrier 63e99f45975f9bf237b1afc3490e10aa365caaa0; query.go is identical between the first member and carrier.
protocol_checks.affected_release_membership: CONFIRMED: carrier 63e99f45975f9bf237b1afc3490e10aa365caaa0 is an ancestor of v0.76.2 and v0.75.7, and both tagged trees retain the Config-only org switch without an org-path ACL rebind.
protocol_checks.fixed_release_membership: CONFIRMED: master fix 8c9bf842ea8a5f7b25c73bfe8a5e390524239ab5 is contained by v0.77.1 but not v0.76.2; backport 1c6f3b700d6723566c6538ad8d00e0824e3d54a6 is on v0.76-release and contained by v0.76.4 but not v0.76.2; backport cac40fc35af5f8e8742a0b45219f139f53a731a5 follows v0.75.7 and is on v0.75-release. The vendor advisory identifies fixed releases 0.76.3 and 0.75.8.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: CONFIRMED: direct master fix 8c9bf842ea8a5f7b25c73bfe8a5e390524239ab5 and both release backports add builder.ACLManager = NewServerACLManager(target org, GetPrincipal(scope)), directly removing reuse of the source-org ACL token.
protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: CONFIRMED: BIC 416a2e9d7e076b49aa532db6bbb257ecccf596d3 is authored and committed by Mike Cohen <mike@velocidex.com>; its full commit object has no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot, or other AI marker. Attribution was judged from this BIC only, not the squash carrier or fix.
